<h2 class="uk-h2">
                    Information        
</h2>
<div id="page#1" class="uk-margin">
<ul class="el-nav uk-margin-medium uk-subnav uk-subnav-pill" uk-switcher="connect: #js-1; animation: uk-animation-fade;">        <li>

        <div id="js-1" class="uk-switcher" uk-height-match="row: false">
                        <div class="el-item uk-margin-remove-first-child">
                <h3 class="el-title uk-h3 uk-margin-top uk-margin-remove-bottom">Check IN/OUT</h3>        
                <div class="el-content uk-panel uk-margin-top">– Check-in starts between 09:00 and 22:00.
<br/>– Earliest check-in: 12:00 hrs.
<br/>– Late departure: 12:00 hrs.</div>        
</div>                        <div class="el-item uk-margin-remove-first-child">
                <h3 class="el-title uk-h3 uk-margin-top uk-margin-remove-bottom">Basics</h3>        
                <div class="el-content uk-panel uk-margin-top">
<p>– Credit cards accepted <br>– No time limit <br>– Non-smokers <br>– VAT included (10%)<br>– Breakfast not included.<br>– There is a storage area luggage on the day of Check out.<br>– Sheets are included in the price and we offer a laundry service.<br>– Adapted for people with reduced mobility.</p></div>        
</div>                        <div class="el-item uk-margin-remove-first-child">
                <h3 class="el-title uk-h3 uk-margin-top uk-margin-remove-bottom">Payments</h3>        
                <div class="el-content uk-panel uk-margin-top"><p>– Payment upon arrival in cash, credit cards, debit cards.</p></div>        
</div>                        <div class="el-item uk-margin-remove-first-child">
                <h3 class="el-title uk-h3 uk-margin-top uk-margin-remove-bottom"> Cancellation policy</h3>        
                <div class="el-content uk-panel uk-margin-top"><p> – The property will reauthorize the card prior to arrival. A 30% charge will be made as the reservation is made. This is to guarantee your reservation and is non-refundable.
<br>– If you cancel your reservation 15 days before arrival, the hostel will not charge anything. Between 15 days and the arrival the total of the reservation will be charged. No Show will be charged 100%.</p></div>
